transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As we're all aware, we received a deficiency letter regarding our marketed pediatric monitoring device, and we have 30 calendar days to submit our written response to the regulator. They've asked us to clarify several areas: the device's software scope, manufacturing controls, pediatric labeling, and how we handle supporting patient data. I understand a draft response has been circulated internally, but it hasn't been approved or submitted yet, and there are still unresolved questions about software scope, lot disposition, the pediatric indication, and the patient-data fields to be included. We need to close those gaps quickly so we can finalize and get this response submitted on time. I'd like to hear from each of you on where things stand in your respective areas.
